highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 brings m150 fixes for Ganesh GPU rendering and SkSL raster-pipeline code generation.
highlights_body: It prevents stale texture readbacks after failed flushes, restores dirty tracking when resolve tasks fail, and corrects framebuffer cleanup on Imagination GPUs.

bullets.lead: Skia m150 servicing fixes rolled forward
bullets.detail: Includes four upstream syncs covering SkSL raster-pipeline lifetime safety, failed Ganesh flush and resolve handling, stale readbacks, and Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion.

harfbuzz_summary: Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2 with this SkiaSharp servicing release.
